tagline: Global private markets investment solutions provider
hero_kpi_rationale: The AUM KPI is the Hero because it directly reflects the company's ability to attract and manage client assets, which is the primary driver of its management fee revenues and performance incentives.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total amount of assets managed discretely by the company
kpis.description: The company manages assets discretely on behalf of its clients, including customized separate accounts and specialized funds

kpis.name: Assets Under Advisement
kpis.explanation: Total amount of assets for which the company provides non-discretionary advice
kpis.description: The company provides advisory and investment recommendation services for client assets without discretionary authority

kpis.name: Number of employees
kpis.description: The company has 760 employees, including 265 investment professionals across 22 global offices
kpis.signal: Growth in headcount and investment resources

kpis.name: Assets Under Management as of March 31, 2025
kpis.explanation: Total amount of assets managed discretely by the company in the last quarter
kpis.description: Assets under management include $98.8 billion in customized separate accounts and $39.5 billion in specialized funds

risks.title: Past performance is not indicative of future results
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in the 10-K and repeated multiple times with strong language (not necessarily indicative, could cause a decline). It directly affects investor perception and revenues. The Capital category is highly weighted.

risks.title: Increased competition for investment opportunities
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights increased competition in private markets and credit markets. The language is repeated and emphasizes a direct impact on future returns. Central positioning in the document.

risks.title: Loss of clients in custom management
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described as materially and adversely affect with contracts terminable within 30-90 days. Mention of periodic renewal of public contracts, which increases vulnerability.

risks.title: Conflicts of interest in advice and allocations
risks.score_rationale: Very strong language: material adverse effect on our reputation, regulatory enforcement, fiduciary duty. Risk related to the SEC and legal obligations. Regulation category is highly critical.

risks.title: Departure of key personnel or key event
risks.score_rationale: Mention of a key person event that could suspend the investment period. Alarming language: materially and adversely affect. High position in the document and direct operational impact.

risks.title: Expansion into retail investors and tokenization
risks.score_rationale: New initiative exposing the company to greater levels of risk. Strong language: heightened litigation, regulatory enforcement and reputational risks. Technology category with cross-cutting impact.

risks.title: High redemptions in evergreen funds
risks.score_rationale: Risk related to difficult market conditions and redemption limits. Mention of reputational harm and impact on flows. Positioned at the end of the document but with significant language.

ai_positioning.summary: The company HLNE does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report as of March 31, 2025.
